details: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde has advocated for a European safe-haven asset to compete with US Treasuries, emphasizing the need for a stronger global competitor. She noted that existing assets like German bonds offer lower convenience yields. This initiative is linked to the broader Capital Markets Union project and aims to provide robust sovereign-debt backing for euro-denominated stablecoins, which currently rely heavily on dollar debt instruments.
title: ECB President Calls for European Safe Asset to Rival US Treasuries

details: Leaders from the US Federal Reserve, European Central Bank (ECB), Bank of England, and Bank of Canada have collectively opposed the use of explicit forward guidance on interest rates. They argue that committing to specific policy paths limits flexibility during changing economic conditions, leading to increased market uncertainty. The ECB plans to adopt a "Framework Guidance" focusing on data interpretation rather than fixed forecasts, suggesting less predictable central bank communication ahead.
title: Major Central Banks Reject Forward Guidance on Interest Rates, Signaling More Market Uncertainty

details: On July 8, Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced $84.9 million in outflows, reversing a modest inflow from the previous day. In contrast, Ether ETFs recorded significant inflows of $70.5 million, primarily led by Fidelity's FETH. Solana ETFs, however, saw $8.6 million in outflows. The total crypto market capitalization eased slightly by 0.86% over the past day, standing at $2.16 trillion.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Outflows, Ether ETFs Gain on July 8th

details: Jim Thorne, Chief Market Strategist at Wellington-Altus Private Wealth, anticipates that the next move by the US Federal Reserve will be lower interest rates, driven by productivity gains helping to contain inflation. He expressed a bullish outlook on the S&P 500 and believes Bitcoin is increasingly entering the financial mainstream as blockchain adoption accelerates and regulatory clarity improves. Thorne suggests that current Bitcoin prices present an opportunity before wider adoption.
title: Analyst Predicts Lower US Interest Rates and Growing Bitcoin Mainstream Adoption
